name: Gilnid
summary: Deep in the Deadmines, Gilnid runs the goblin forges for the Defias Brotherhood. Known as the Smelter, he oversees the work that turns raw ore into refined metal and munitions for Edwin VanCleef's hidden ironclad juggernaut. His foundry makes the heavy cannons the Brotherhood needs to strike Stormwind.

sections.title: Master of the Foundry
sections.body: Deep in the Deadmines, the Defias Brotherhood depends on skilled hands to forge its weapons of war. Gilnid, VanCleef's head smelter, commands goblin laborers, tinkers, and smiths in the central foundry. Taller than most of his kin, he drives them through smoke and slag, barking orders and allowing no breaks. Their work turns raw iron ore into heavy plating and deadly ordnance.

sections.title: Arming the Juggernaut
sections.body: Gilnid's foundry feeds the Brotherhood's great ambition. He oversees the heavy cannons and ammunition meant for the colossal ironclad warship docked in a subterranean cove beyond his workshop. The Defias vessel cannot make its planned strike against Stormwind until his crew has forged every gun, barrel, and ball.

faq.answer: Gilnid is a goblin engineer and Edwin VanCleef's head smelter in the Deadmines. He oversees the Brotherhood's forges and directs the work of casting cannons and ammunition for its war machine.

faq.q: Why is Gilnid in the Deadmines?
aliases: why is a goblin in deadmines
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood hired goblin engineers to build and supply its hidden warship. Gilnid leads the smelting works, turning mined iron ore into refined parts, armor, and artillery.
Gilnid oversees the cannons, ship parts, and shot needed to arm the juggernaut hidden in the docks deeper inside the mines.
Gilnid controls the foundry blocking the way to the cove. The heavy blast doors deeper in the mines remain sealed until the smelting room is secured.

faq.q: Does Gilnid work directly for Edwin VanCleef?
faq.answer: Yes. Gilnid is a contracted goblin specialist who serves directly under VanCleef, handling heavy metalwork and weapons production. He was not one of the original Stonemasons.

faq.q: Why are there so many goblins around him?
faq.answer: Gilnid leads a goblin engineering crew in the foundry. They operate the blast furnaces, pour molten iron, and assemble ordnance under his strict supervision.

angles.text: Gilnid's blast furnaces and smelting pots show how the Defias Brotherhood turns Westfall's raw minerals into refined iron and weapons.
Gilnid's foundry shows goblin heavy industry at work, producing naval cannons, ammunition, and structural plating under harsh conditions.
Stopping Gilnid shuts down the Defias weapons line and keeps VanCleef's warship from being fully armed to threaten Stormwind Harbor.
